text_block_list.text:
No sooner has the Takarazuka Kinen
finished
than this year's summer camp
begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув has just had her big rematch
with
Сайленс Судзука, and yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Come on, time for roll call. Everyone get
to the
assembly point!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...she still has to oversee the camp as
part of the
student council.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At a glance, Эйр Грув looks as highly
motivated
as ever as we prepare for her
comeback at the
Sapporo Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Maybe Эйр Грув isn't aware of it
herself, but
glimpses of her dark mood
are slipping through.
She's clearly less
talkative than usual too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I never expected to see Эйр Грув like
this. It's
as though she's become a
different person
entirely.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It appears that dark clouds of
uncertainty have
settled around her.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen has taken a
bigger toll on
her than she realizes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her like this pains me as well. I
wonder if
there's something I can say to
cheer her up.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Although even if there were...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I think you're the only one who can truly
get her
back on her feet.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: After all, you're her one and only trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Don't hesitate to seek me out should
you ever
need my assistance.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Godspeed.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I wonder what I can possibly say to Air
Groove...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I look back on all the time we've spent
together
and rack my brain for
something I can do to help.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to help her find her footing again
at the
G2 Sapporo Kinen, ready to storm
the G1
challenge waiting in the fall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But in order to do that, I need to get Air
Groove
up and running now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
